name: Exp_ColorZerolagJCCX
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the ColorZerolagJCCX oscillator, a zero-lag composite momentum indicator built from five weighted JCCX components with JJMA smoothing. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable options for entry and exit on each signal direction.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagJCCX振荡器的交叉信号进行交易，这是一个由五个加权JCCX分量和JJMA平滑构建的零滞后复合动量指标。当主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，反向穿越时开空仓，并支持对每个方向的入场和出场进行独立配置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ColorZerolagJCCX零滞后动量振荡器的双线交叉系统。入场条件为：当主线Osc1上穿信号线Osc2时产生做多信号，同时若主线从上方下穿信号线则触发卖出开仓；交叉方向的反转自动触发反向仓位的平仓信号。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），以及交叉信号的反转平仓机制。仓位管理采用基于资金比例（MM=0.1）和可切换的LOT/FREE_MARGIN/LOT_STEP模式，通过TradeAlgorithms库的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数执行。资金管理方面，MM参数控制每笔交易的资金比例，默认0.1表示较保守的仓位规模。策略还引入了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线内重复开仓，并使用SignalBar=1确保信号确认后再入场，减少假突破风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a dual-line crossover system based on the ColorZerolagJCCX zero-lag momentum oscillator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the main line Osc1 crosses above the signal line Osc2, while a sell signal fires on the reverse crossover; the crossover direction reversal automatically triggers closing of the opposing position. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss (1000 points) and take-profit (2000 points), plus the crossover reversal close mechanism. Position sizing uses a money percentage approach (MM=0.1) with switchable LOT/FREE_MARGIN/LOT_STEP modes, executed through the TradeAlgorithms library's BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter, with a default of 0.1 indicating a relatively conservative position size relative to account equity. The strategy also incorporates a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated entries within the same bar, and uses SignalBar=1 to ensure signal confirmation before entry, reducing false breakout risk.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（固定手数/可用保证金/手数步长）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode: fixed lot/balance/free margin

pros: 零滞后指标设计减少了传统动量指标的延迟问题，使信号更及时
独立的买卖开仓和平仓开关提供了灵活的策略控制，可以只做单边交易
使用新K线检测和SignalBar确认机制，有效避免同根K线内重复开仓和虚假信号
多分量加权复合（5个不同周期JCCX）提高了振荡器的稳定性和可靠性
有固定的止损和止盈设置，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: The zero-lag indicator design reduces the delay problem of traditional momentum indicators, making signals more timely
Independent buy/sell open and close switches provide flexible strategy control, allowing single-direction trading only
New bar detection and SignalBar confirmation mechanism effectively prevent repeated entries within the same bar and false signals
Multi-component weighted composite (5 JCCX with different periods) improves the oscillator's stability and reliability
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在高点差时段可能产生不利入场
没有追踪止损或动态止损机制，固定止损可能无法适应市场波动性变化
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点在H4周期上偏大，可能承受较大浮亏
依赖外部自定义指标ColorZerolagJCCX，若该指标未正确安装则EA无法运行
cons_en: Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which may lead to unfavorable entries during high-spread periods
No trailing stop or dynamic stop mechanism; fixed stop-loss cannot adapt to changing market volatility
No position check logic; may repeatedly open positions in the same direction when one already exists
Stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are relatively large on H4 timeframe, potentially enduring significant drawdowns
Depends on the external custom indicator ColorZerolagJCCX; the EA cannot run if the indicator is not properly installed
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在流动性差的时间段入场
添加持仓检查逻辑，防止同向重复开仓导致过度敞口
引入追踪止损或基于ATR的动态止损止盈，适应不同市场波动环境
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid entries during low-liquidity periods
Add position check logic to prevent repeated same-direction entries that lead to excessive exposure
Introduce trailing stop or ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit to adapt to different market volatility environments

risk_points: 没有持仓数量检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度杠杆
固定止损1000点在极端行情下仍可能被跳空穿越造成更大损失
缺少点差和滑点上限的有效保护机制，Deviation_=10可能不够
risk_points_en: No position count check; may repeatedly open same-direction positions leading to excessive leverage
Fixed 1000-point stop-loss can still be gapped over in extreme market conditions causing larger losses
Lacks effective spread and slippage protection; Deviation_=10 may be insufficient during volatile periods
